statements.status_notes: The advisory covers the unmaintained golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages. The 0.13 binary lists the module only because helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance (github.com/rancher/helm/v3 v3.19.0-rancher1, required through github.com/rancher/rancher) imports it, and the golang.org/x/crypto bump that clears the advisory's other range moves those packages into this module. go tool nm on the 0.13 -dev binary lists no symbol from golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp or from helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance, the binary carries no openpgp function name or source path beyond its build-info module entry, and govulncheck -mode=binary reports GO-2026-5932 at module level only, so no openpgp code is linked.

The advisory covers the unmaintained golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages. The 0.13 binary lists the module only because helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance (github.com/rancher/helm/v3 v3.19.0-rancher1, required through github.com/rancher/rancher) imports it, and the golang.org/x/crypto bump that clears the advisory's other range moves those packages into this module. go tool nm on the 0.13 -dev binary lists no symbol from golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp or from helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance, the binary carries no openpgp function name or source path beyond its build-info module entry, and govulncheck -mode=binary reports GO-2026-5932 at module level only, so no openpgp code is linked.

GO-2026-5932 is scoped to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version; newer builds also report it on the standalone golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp module identity (0.1.0-deprecated). Kyverno-family binaries (including kyverno-init) ship golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp: go tool nm on dhi/kyverno-init:1.19.1-debian13 reports extensive golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, openpgp/packet, openpgp/armor, and openpgp/s2k symbols, consistent with Sigstore-related dependencies (for example github.com/sigstore/rekor) in the build graph. No patched golang.org/x/crypto release exists; remediation requires upstream Kyverno or its Sigstore dependencies to migrate off x/crypto/openpgp.

GO-2026-5932 covers the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package, which upstream declares unmaintained and unsafe by design with no fixed version. The package enters the image through github.com/sigstore/rekor and helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/provenance. Rekor v1.5.4 and later no longer import it. Source-controller builds of the 1.6 and 1.7 lines that use rekor v1.5.4 contain no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp symbols, and the current 1.9 and 1.10 builds contain none either. Earlier published 1.6 builds still include the package (openpgp@v0.1.0-deprecated in the SBOM), so this statement stays under investigation until the rebuilt 1.6 and 1.7 images are published and the finding is confirmed on them. No patched golang.org/x/crypto release exists for the openpgp package.
